name: OpenRouter
summary: One API for many AI models.

flows.title: Find a model in the catalogue
steps: Open openrouter.ai/models. The catalogue renders without signing in, so there is no step through the home page first.
Type part of a model's name into the Search models… box above the list.
Narrow the list with the checkboxes and the dropdowns beside that box.
The row of tabs beginning with All limits the list by what a model does: Text, Image, Video, Speech, Transcription, Embeddings and Rerank.
List and Table switch how the results are laid out. Select a model's name to open its own page.
